request.query: For positive B a power t^n is less than B^d if n log t < d log B

content.text:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "formal_name": "Nat.lt_pow_of_log_lt",
      "informal_name": "Logarithmic Inequality Preserves Exponential Bound in Natural Numbers",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {b x y : ℕ}, 1 < b → Nat.log b y < x → y < b ^ x",
      "informal_description": "For natural numbers $b, x, y$ with $b > 1$, if the floor of the base-$b$ logarithm of $y$ is less than $x$, then $y < b^x$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Log"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Real.lt_pow_of_log_lt",
      "informal_name": "Logarithmic Inequality Implies Power Inequality for Positive Real Numbers",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {x y : ℝ} {n : ℕ}, 0 < y → Real.log x < ↑n * Real.log y → x < y ^ n",
      "informal_description": "For any real number $ x $ and positive real number $ y $, if the natural logarithm of the absolute value of $ x $ is less than $ n $ times the natural logarithm of $ y $, then $ x $ is less than $ y $ raised to the power of $ n $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Real.pow_lt_of_lt_log",
      "informal_name": "Exponential Inequality from Logarithmic Inequality",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {x y : ℝ} {n : ℕ}, 0 < y → Real.log x < ↑n * Real.log y → x < y ^ n",
      "informal_description": "For real numbers $x$ and $y$ with $y > 0$, if $\\ln|x| < n \\ln y$, then $x < y^n$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Real.lt_zpow_of_log_lt",
      "informal_name": "Inequality: $\\log x < n \\log y$ Implies $x < y^n$",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {x y : ℝ} {n : ℤ}, 0 < y → Real.log x < ↑n * Real.log y → x < y ^ n",
      "informal_description": "For any real number $x$ and positive real number $y$, if the natural logarithm of the absolute value of $x$ (with $\\log 0$ defined as 0) is less than $n$ times the natural logarithm of $y$, then $x$ is less than $y$ raised to the power of $n$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Real.zpow_lt_of_lt_log",
      "informal_name": "Exponential Inequality from Logarithmic Inequality",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {x y : ℝ} {n : ℤ}, 0 < y → Real.log x < ↑n * Real.log y → x < y ^ n",
      "informal_description": "For any real numbers $x$ and $y$ with $y > 0$ and integer $n$, if $\\ln x < n \\ln y$, then $x < y^n$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real"
    }
  ]
}
